description: Promote to environment — Promotes the source environment's current content + code into this environment. Runs the unified deployment in-process: it writes the env-keyed `template_snapshot`, atomically commits the env pointer, AND dispatches the managed code build — this CLOSES the env-pin → code-deploy gap (a promote now deploys code, not just content). Returns 202 with the created `deployment` row; the snapshot + env-pointer commit are already done, while the build runs asynchronously — poll `GET /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}` to watch `code_status` reach `deployed`. The default environment cannot be a promote target.
name: promote_environment
